QEC Mastering Books

কিউইসি-র নিজস্ব প্রকাশনা

Written by QEC teachers for the way we teach. Each book has chapter practice, solved examples and test papers, so home study follows the class.

Titles and prices are samples. The publications team will add the final list, covers and prices.

How to Get the Books

Enrolled students receive the books for their class at admission. Anyone else can order them by phone or from the office.

Order by Phone

Call 01841-233235 or message us on WhatsApp with the book name and your class.

Online ordering with cash on delivery will open with the new website backend.
